reason: A live camera on my mom feels like watching her every minute, and she would hate it, even with privacy mode. I would also be recording strangers and other people's kids in the background, which I am not comfortable with.
objection: Whether putting a camera on a person with dementia respects her dignity and consent, when she may not understand she is being filmed.
would_change_my_mind: A GPS-only mode with no camera, with wandering alerts and a clear rule that video is never on unless a caregiver is responding to an SOS.
